dataformat.name: swiftMt
dataformat.title: SWIFT MT
dataformat.description: Encode and decode SWIFT MT messages
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,finance

marshalIn.description: A Prowide MT message, such as an MT103, as unmarshal gives. The body is not converted: MT text fails

marshalOut.description: The MT message in FIN format, or JSON with writeInJson, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: An MT message in FIN format

unmarshalOut.description: The Prowide class of the message type, such as MT103; null when the type is not known

writeInJson.description: Whether to marshal messages in JSON format.
